sentences.text: The Hon'ble JUSTICE SOUMEN SEN Date : 16th January, 2014.

Appearance:
Mr. S.K. Das, Adv.
Mr. T.K. Sen, Adv.
Ms. N. Adhya, Adv.
. . .for the defendant no.7.
Mr. R.K. Chowdhury, Adv.
Mr. T. Saraf, Adv.
. . .for the plaintiff.
The Court: Mr. Ais Kumar, the authorized officer on behalf of the Food and Safety and Standards Authority of India, Kolkata is present.

entities.text: Food and Safety and Standards Authority of India, Kolkata
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
He has filed a report as directed R. Piyarelall Import And Export Ltd vs Agrozan Commodities Dmcc & Ors on 16 January, 2014 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47023330/
1 earlier.

entities.text: R. Piyarelall Import And Export Ltd vs Agrozan Commodities Dmcc & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the report he stated that the Food and Safety and Standards Authority of India is responsible for implementation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 which deals with food of human consumption and does not deal with animal food.

entities.text: Food and Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The authorized officer is also not an expert in animal food or environmental pollution.
Therefore, the said officer expresses its inability to comment whether the consignment of Russian Yellow Peas is fit for animal food or for fertilizer.

The said officer, however, submitted that so far he is aware, the parties may approach West Bengal University of Fisheries and Animal Sciences, (Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairy), for obtaining an opinion in this regard.

entities.text: West Bengal University of Fisheries and Animal Sciences
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The report filed by the authorized officer is kept with the record.
Let this matter appear for orders tomorrow.
All parties concerned are to act on a signed photocopy of this order on the usual undertakings.

(SOUMEN SEN, J.) sp/
